name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Blood's Curse) — Advanced — The Withering of Ages

system.description: By winning a Physical Challenge against her target, the thaumaturge strips away the target's immortality, aging her physically one decade for each Willpower Trait the thaumaturge spends. Each decade costs the target two Physical Traits (to a minimum of zero, at which point she cannot move, feed, defend herself or speak above a whisper, cannot initiate challenges, and loses Appearance-based Social Traits). Every five decades aged also inflicts the Negative Traits Decrepit and Repugnant. The target may restore herself by spending one Willpower and five Blood Traits in the same turn. This power lasts one night, after which the victim returns to her natural age. This path may only be learned by Kindred of 10th generation or weaker, and its powers only function against vampires of equal or better generation. It retests with the Occult Ability.
